item.title: 🟠 Critical PwnEscape Linux Kernel Vulnerability Lets Guest VMs Read Host Memory
item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality-system impact — consider guest services, PMS/POS, and property operations.
A newly disclosed critical flaw in the Linux kernel allows code inside a virtual machine to read memory on the host computer it runs on. A researcher demonstrated the leak against Vercel's live cloud sandboxes, and Vercel confirmed it. The flaw, now tracked as CVE-2026-99999 and nicknamed PwnEscape, is in the Linux kernel's networking code, not in any one cloud's setup, so it reaches the shared

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: <1h

item.title: 🔴 CVE-2026-102858 Microsoft Office OneNote Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description:
Why this matters: Remote-code-execution risk — assess exposure and patch or mitigate quickly.
Microsoft is announcing the availability of the security updates for Microsoft Office for Mac. Customers running affected Mac software should install the update for their product to be protected from this vulnerability. Customers running other Microsoft Office software do not need to take any action. See the [Release Notes](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=831049) for more information and download links.
